Description

It carries you to a summer morning, among blossoming citrus groves and freshly picked fruit, capturing the clear light of the Mediterranean coast.

A new fresh and luminous fragrance for living spaces that blends citrus notes, the energy of bergamot and enveloping woods, creating a clear and regenerating atmosphere.

The inspiration

Inspired by a morning on the terraces of the Mediterranean coast, the new Bergamotto Verde fragrance recalls the calm of a walk through the citrus groves, where the sun filters through the glossy leaves and the air seems to smell of the sea. It is that perfect moment when the bergamot is still green and ready to be picked, and all around, a vibrant harmony of citrus scents rises from the garden. A timeless trace of the Mediterranean summer, captured for the home.

The olfactory pyramid
  • Green bergamot, Lemon leaf
  • Orange blossom, Petitgrain
  • Cedarwood, Guaiac wood, Oakmoss

The green, vibrant opening of bergamot and lemon leaf awakens the senses with a sparkling, luminous freshness, evoking the vitality of a Mediterranean citrus grove. The citrus and floral heart reveals the delicacy of orange blossom, enhanced by the green nuances of petitgrain. The base of cedar and guaiac woods, wrapped in oakmoss, gives earthy depth and enveloping persistence.
